entries.title: Install Node.js with NVM (Ubuntu / WSL / macOS)
entries.summary: NVM installs and switches Node versions per user, with no sudo.
entries.when: Setting up a new Linux/WSL machine.

steps.label: 1. Install NVM (check github.com/nvm-sh/nvm for the newest version number)
2. Reload your shell (or close and reopen the terminal)
3. Install and select the current LTS Node

entries.expected: node and npm print version numbers; new terminals still use that version.
troubleshooting: 'nvm: command not found': the installer adds lines to ~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc - check they exist and re-source the file.
'curl: command not found': sudo apt install curl.
Do not use 'sudo npm install -g' with NVM; it is not needed.

entries.title: Install Node.js on Windows (nvm-windows or winget)
entries.summary: Two supported routes: nvm-windows (many versions) or winget (one LTS).
entries.when: Setting up Node natively on Windows.

code: Uninstall any existing Node.js first, then run nvm-setup.exe and reopen PowerShell.
steps.label: Option A: nvm-windows
Then install and select LTS
steps.dir: Any directory (may need Administrator PowerShell for 'nvm use')

steps.label: Option B: winget (single LTS version, reopen PowerShell afterwards)

troubleshooting: 'nvm is not recognized': reopen PowerShell, or reinstall nvm-windows.
nvm-windows does not read .nvmrc automatically; run 'nvm use X.Y.Z' manually.

entries.title: Which package manager does this project use?
entries.summary: The lockfile tells you whether to use npm, yarn, pnpm or bun.
entries.when: Right after cloning, before installing dependencies.
entries.where: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

code: ls package-lock.json yarn.lock pnpm-lock.yaml bun.lockb bun.lock 2>/dev/null
steps.dir: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)
Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

steps.label: yarn/pnpm missing? Corepack ships with most Node versions (or: npm install -g pnpm)

entries.expected: Exactly one lockfile is listed - use its package manager and do not mix.
troubleshooting: Two lockfiles present: follow the README; delete nothing without asking the maintainers.
